name: trend-pullback-250-v1
hypothesis: On Binance Spot 15-minute candles, a confirmed recovery from a shallow pullback inside a rising multi-day trend will produce a positive net expectancy after 0.20% cost per side across BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, and SOL/USDT.
mechanism: The slow EMA regime filter avoids countertrend longs, while the price-and-RSI recovery confirmation enters after short-term weakness instead of chasing an already extended breakout.
major_change: Replace the baseline's fast volatility-compression breakout and 10-candle channel exit with one coherent slow-regime pullback/recovery signal pair; risk and capital limits remain unchanged.
